name: Instagram Browse, Like and Comment
description: One manual run in the Windows local edition: process 5 to 8 distinct feed posts, like if needed, publish the configured public comment, then stop. No recurring schedule.

nodes.name: Manual Start
nodes.notes: Runs only when Run Workflow is clicked. No timer is created.

nodes.name: Instagram Browse, Like and Comment
nodes.notes: Windows portable edition only. Opens a dedicated Edge profile; sign in manually on first run. Selects 5-8 eligible posts. Skips posts previously recorded by this runner and never retries an uncertain comment submission. Stop Instagram cancels remaining work. Test Selected does not like or comment. Run Workflow does.
